adversarial_controls: Arbitrary finite-order eta, including order not dividing6: the moving Kummer characters have orderdividing6, but fixedeta only changes the finite excludedset and unitarytwist; its complex component is trivial. No hidden reduction to Dirichlet or a single Eisenstein field was used.
Principaleta and a possibly principal denominator row: the reciprocalzero at1 is harmless; at most one principal denominator row is included in the exceptional set. Onlyu=1 has a principal numerator.
Wild primes and smallnorm primes: they lie in finiteS, fixed before the family. Their deletion produces no positive-real-part zeros; all moving badprimes atdivisorsu are estimated separately.
Shared cube/squarefree prime: c=p,n=p gives valuation4 with Whittaker valueQ^-3/2*g2, agreeing withgamma2(c)/(sqrt(q_c)q_n). Cubefactors were not silently made coprime.

Maskedj=0 at a positive modulus differs from an absent modulus; the former remains zero on nonunits and retains both zero/nonzero Fourierdigits. Dropping this distinction would invalidate several local sums; the source preserves it.
Reflected lengthbelow1: the retained set is empty and profiledecay bounds the tail. No invocation of the quadratic sieve with a fictitious fractional column is needed.
